items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Governor Claiborne was, he was governing Russia.

ctx.x: Governor Claiborne was, he was governing Russia. There were three brothers on the streets with AMAP, the Claiborne, Bienville, and Ivorville.
Well, I think Claiborne was later. They gave us the first American governor when he came to.
